race.description: Fastplast Building Supplies Hastings Cup Hcp
race.comment: Good race to close the day out. XTREME (13) consistent gelding who doesn't have to improve much to win this. Nailed late with the 58kg when third over this trip at Rosehill in Highway company. Trained locally and expected to fight out the finish. KAIHOKO (9) blinkers come off, and he jumps in trip third up. Senior rider hops aboard after he warmed up late when fifth over 1200m at Tamworth. Each way contender. PRINCE OF SORTS (2) tough on pace gelding who doesn't have to improve much to win this. Visors come off today after he folded up late to finish fifth over 1400m at Hawkesbury. Will be in this for a long way at the good odds. GOLDEN COPPER (6) returned to form with a comfortable on speed victory over this track and trip with Smyth's claim. Drops further in weight from the sticky gate and keep safe.
